- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~1149 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: HTTP 5xx classification misses some common variants.
  WHY: The regex `http 5[0-9][0-9]` only matches one lowercase layout, so strings like `HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout` or `Received HTTP 504` can fall through to `unknown_probe_failure`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~1216 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: x-access-token redaction may miss uncommon token formats.
  WHY: The pattern `x-access-token:[^@[:space:]]+` assumes the token never contains `@`, so unusual or URL-encoded forms could be redacted incompletely and logged.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~1150 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Transient transport classifier misses common SSL/network failures.
  WHY: Errors like `ssl certificate problem`, `host key verification failed`, `remote hung up unexpectedly`, and `connection refused` still fall through to `unknown_probe_failure`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~1180-1182 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Timeout wrapper is only checked for existence, not compatible behavior.
  WHY: `command -v timeout` does not verify GNU-compatible syntax or that `timeout 30s` will actually work, so the push probe can still hang until the job times out.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~1179-1183 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Dry-run preflight can become stale before the actual push.
  WHY: `git push --dry-run` only snapshots pushability at check time, so another push between the probe and the later real push can make the preflight result obsolete even though downstream stale-base handling exists.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
